assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of unexplained syncope and near-syncope, raising concern for intermittent arrhythmia.
Given the personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
prolonged mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered
This service was rendered under diagnosis codes R55 and Z86.73
the required precertification was not obtained before services were provided
